english.title: Registered person carry on a regulated activity whilst registration suspended
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been registered under Chapter 2 of Part 1 of the Health and Social Care Act 2008 as a service provider in respect of a regulated activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..), carried on that activity while your registration was suspended

english.notes:
(i) Section 86 specifies the conditions and requirements for the Care Quality Commission to give a penalty notice in cases of fixed penalty offences.
(ii) The Health and Social Care Act 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regulations 2014 (regulation 24 and Schedule 5) prescribe fixed penalty offences for the purposes of section 86 (which includes this offence) as well as the amount of the penalties and other relevant matters. Be aware that the provisions contained in these Regulations only apply in relation to regulated activities carried on in England ).
(iii) Note that section 13 of the Act (not on the database) requires, as a condition on the registration of a service provider, that they have a registered manager to manage certain regulated activities in prescribed circumstances.
